# Parallax

> Self-hosted network looking glass with a Go server, remote Go agents and a React dashboard. Diagnose connectivity across locations with live probes, scheduled checks and a node-to-node latency matrix.

Parallax supports ping, traceroute, mtr, nexttrace, iperf3, speedtest, dns, http,
tcp, tls, dnsbench and download. The last four are Go-native. It also provides
PTY sessions, saved-run links, diagnostic kits, Prometheus metrics and webhook
alerts. Shell sessions default to enabled; public sessions cannot open shells.

The repository is the project source. A self-hosted instance's nodes, schedules,
credentials and saved results are operator data, not project documentation.
The project is released under the MIT license.

- [Configuration and API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EMOEMOJAI/Parallax/main/docs/reference.md): Probe support, agent flags, environment variables and route authentication.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EMOEMOJAI/Parallax/main/docs/architecture.md): Protocol, concurrency, persistence and compatibility.
